headline: The studio's contact form had been rendering its name, email and subject fields at 22px instead of 48px on every theme; found by looking at the pixels, not from the board.

items.title: Contact form fields render at their designed height
items.insight: .input-field carries flex: 1 for horizontal email rows. Inside Contact's column-flex .form-group that zeroes the flex-basis on the vertical axis and overrides height: 48px, so the main inbound form showed cramped fields with placeholder text against the borders. Not on any board; found during the rendered-pixel pass for an unrelated heading change.
items.evidence: getBoundingClientRect 22px before, 48px after, desktop and mobile, dark and light; 42/42 theme captures opened

items.title: A cleanup that had never deleted anything
items.insight: The board asked for a new prune of superseded hashed shells. One already existed: its regex ended in an escaped `\${`, so the extension was never interpolated and the pattern matched no file. Every rotation since left its old CSS and JS tracked and publicly servable.
items.evidence: Reproduced in node (false for a real stale name); fixed with an escape helper; 8 stale shells pruned; shell --check in sync

items.title: Background tabs stop polling what nobody can see
items.insight: favicon-pulse and vault-pulse polled presence and rotated ticker rows in hidden tabs. They now pause while hidden and refresh once on return, so a reader sees current state the moment they come back. desk-presence already skipped its network call; that half of the carried premise was false.
items.evidence: document.hidden guards plus visibilitychange refresh in all three scripts; 215/215 mobile cells

items.title: Three public pages now outline correctly
items.insight: Community, Journal and Contact jumped from h1 to h3, so a screen reader or agent navigating by headings saw a broken hierarchy. Demoted to h2 with font-family: inherit so the rendered look is unchanged.
items.evidence: 42/42 captures reviewed across 7 themes x 2 viewports; element shots of each changed heading

items.title: The cut-off S349 follow-up is back on the record
items.insight: A clean tree hid a closeout that never ran: 50f13941 landed 20.7h after the last write-back. Recovered before any new work, with its CANON-055 exemption declared because its only effect is a CI probe's output and exit code.
items.evidence: check-writeback-currency flagged it; recorded across handoff, work log, state and SIL
